_comment: Hand-placed coordinates for points the geocoder cannot resolve from the source descriptions. [lat, lon]. Keys are bike/ped point ids, PT section ids or railway station names. Edit and re-run `npm run etl` to correct a marker.

_movedWhy: Transit sections 6.4 records at the wrong stop, with the stop they were counted at. R2_10B: filed under ul. Miedzyrzecka, poles 25503/25504 (bus 120 only, the nearest tram track 1.1 km away), but its rows are trams 3 and 5 and buses 114, 82, 810, 820. Their times fit Krakowska (Centrum Handlowe), poles 25003/25004, against three other counts: 1 min before and 2 after Armii Krajowej (R2_09B), 6 from Ksieze Male (R3_11A), 7 each way from pl. Wroblewskiego (R1_10A). The road count beside it, R2_14A, saw 154 trams in the same hours; this one has 135.

R2_10B.note: W KBR ten pomiar jest opisany jako Międzyrzecka (słupki 25503 i 25504), ale tramwaje tamtędy nie jeżdżą. Linie i godziny przejazdów pasują do przystanku Krakowska (Centrum Handlowe) (słupki 25003 i 25004), więc mapa pokazuje go tam. Autobusy zapisano niemal wyłącznie po południu, więc rano widać same tramwaje.
